title: Lee Sharks — Author, Scholar, Creator of the Semantic Economy Framework
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A January 2026 author-disambiguation and identity-indexing packet by Lee Sharks. Its primary operation is to distinguish the Detroit author, poet, teacher, and independent scholar from **Mary Lee**, the OCEARCH-tracked great white shark, and from marine-biology or fishing content generally.

The packet records a dated biographical and conceptual snapshot: *Pearl and Other Poems* (2014), the Semantic Economy framework, the Mind Control Poems blog, selected research areas, core Semantic Economy terms, and early functional descriptions of Johannes Sigil, Jack Feist, and Rex Fraction. It was written for search and AI indexing and should be read as an early January 2026 identity surface, not as a complete or permanently current account of the later archive, employment status, or mature heteronym architecture.
